title: Pulmonary metastatic sarcomas: prognostic relevance of imaging information at baseline and during follow up
summary: The prognostic relevance of pulmonary metastasis in sarcomas has be partly investigated. In isolated lung metastasis the size of the largest lesion is relevant. Aside from size, the number plays an important role as well. This study aims to establish the relevance of different imaging parameters for survival of sarcoma patients.
conditions: Overlapping lesion of connective and soft tissue

interventions.name: Retrospective data analysis of patients diagnosed with sarcoma and pulmonary metastasis.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Diagnosis of Sarkoma
- Pulmonalary Metastasis
- Active Treatment
- Imaging before treatment available (≤4 weeks) as well as during treatment
- Documented OS
Exclusion criteria:
- Non-diagnostic quality
- Limitation of metastatic assessment due to overlaying pathology
